_note: Reader-submitted holiday decoration photos for the Holiday Lights guide (/holiday-lights/). Submissions arrive by email to editor@waynesville.news with the subject "Holiday photo". Add an item ONLY after the editor has reviewed and approved the photo. Rules: the house or business must be in ZIP 45068; the submitter must have taken the photo of their own home or business; family-appropriate; no people's faces (never children), no readable house numbers or license plates. Fields: `kind` "home" or "business". `message` (optional) is a short greeting the submitter wrote, e.g. "Happy holidays from the Smiths"; a family surname is fine when the submitter puts it in their own message, but never first names of children, phone numbers, emails or anything address-like; keep it short and family-appropriate, and trim or drop it if not. Homes: never publish an address, street or house number; the page shows only "Waynesville". Businesses: `business` is the business name as the owner gave it, and `area` may be its address. Convert each image with metadata stripped (this removes GPS location): convert in -strip -auto-orient -resize 1600x1600\> -quality 80 public/images/holiday-photos/<YYYY>-<slug>.webp. `alt` describes the decorations for screen readers. `added` is the date it went up (YYYY-MM-DD). Remove a photo whenever the submitter asks.
